text:
leo: heads up — forecast shows a ~18% shortfall in reserved GPU hours for hosted API in eu-west-1 over the next 30 days. most of the spike is from embeddings traffic. need quick triage.
anya: do we have the daily rolling deploy + model mix metrics? last week embeddings adoption jumped after the docs-search pilot. @margo can you confirm which models are driving it?
margo: quick check — embeddings traffic is up 3.4x over the last 7 days. if trend continues committed coverage drops to ~72% (reserved_hours=4800, expected_demand~=6650).
infra-bot: ALERT: cluster-eu-1 reserved-a pool utilization > 90% (15m window). platform metrics link: https://metrics.internal/clusters/cluster-eu-1/pool/reserved-a
samir: billing flag — i'm seeing line items where committed discounts didn't apply for some burst instances. @cloud-billing can you pull the invoice diff (reserved vs on-demand) for last billing period?
cloud-billing: pulling now. sample metering query i ran:
```
SELECT sku, SUM(hours) as hrs, price
FROM billing.exports
WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND month='2025-11'
GROUP BY sku, price;
```
prelim: ~420 hrs charged at on-demand that should have matched reserved pool (sku:A100-40gb). looks like a tagging/assignment gap.
anya: two immediate levers: 1) route large-batch embed jobs to dedicated-burst pool (canary first); 2) temporarily tighten per-token rate limits on embeddings for free/low-tier keys. both reduce pressure while we sort reservations.
leo: agree. also ask growth to pause new eu signups for a short window until we stabilize — painful but avoids outages.
margo: action items assigned:
- @samir: run audit of billing line items + tag mismatches (due EOD)
- @anya: flip routing policy to dedicated-burst (canary -> 15m observation)
- @leo: coordinate with growth on soft-stop for eu region
- infra-bot: run reservation-allocation calc and post results back here
samir: starting audit now. quick grep from billing export:
```
> grep "A100-40gb" billing_2025-11.csv
billing_2025-11.csv: sku:A100-40gb, hours:420
billing_2025-11.csv: sku:A100-40gb, hours:38
```
looks like two autoscaled pools lacked the proper reservation tag at scale-up.
ops-runbook: runbook check: if reserved coverage < 80% AND utilization > 85% -> escalate to infra-pager + open cloud support case using 'sku-mismatch' template. https://runbook.internal/reservations
leo: scheduling a 30m sync in 10min to decide whether to increase reserved commitment vs request quota bump. also we should open provider-support with the invoice snippets.
anya: noted. leaving a short summary in #incidents and will post routing change timestamps. :white_check_mark:
